verdict.rationale: YYLO is a local CLI. Agents get access to a repository through an `npm install -g` and a `yylo init` run inside a local Git checkout, and a 'Simple' mode is recommended for getting started. Docs also mention installing skills into a repository and bringing GitHub issues into kanban. This is lightweight setup, but it is not a one-click grant of repository access. Missing for 10: a one-click install or app-style authorization flow for granting agent access to hosted repositories, multi-repository access management, and independent or hands-on corroboration that setup is simple.
